turns.question: Reconcile Money Exchange internal transfer reference TRF-2026-1899 across its source and destination till.

row_snapshots.sql: SELECT o.id operation_id,o.terminal_id,o.status,o.created_at,l.currency_code,l.denomination_value,l.physical_count,l.amount FROM money_exchange_till_operation_items l JOIN money_exchange_till_operations o ON o.id=l.till_operation_id JOIN money_exchange_internal_transfers x ON x.source_terminal_id=o.terminal_id AND x.currency_code=l.currency_code WHERE x.reference='TRF-2026-1899' AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.type='float_out' AND o.note=CONCAT('Internal Transfer Out (Ref: ',x.reference,')') AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY o.id,o.terminal_id,o.status,o.created_at,l.currency_code,l.denomination_value,l.physical_count,l.amount LIMIT 500

SELECT o.id operation_id,o.terminal_id,o.status,o.created_at,l.currency_code,l.denomination_value,l.physical_count,l.amount FROM money_exchange_till_operation_items l JOIN money_exchange_till_operations o ON o.id=l.till_operation_id JOIN money_exchange_internal_transfers x ON x.destination_terminal_id=o.terminal_id AND x.currency_code=l.currency_code WHERE x.reference='TRF-2026-1899' AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.type='float_in' AND o.note=CONCAT('Internal Transfer In (Ref: ',x.reference,')') AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY o.id,o.terminal_id,o.status,o.created_at,l.currency_code,l.denomination_value,l.physical_count,l.amount LIMIT 500

SELECT x.reference,x.currency_code,x.amount transfer_amount,v.source_out completed_source_out,v.destination_in completed_destination_in,(v.source_out=x.amount AND v.destination_in=x.amount) both_legs_match_transfer FROM money_exchange_internal_transfers x JOIN (SELECT x.id,SUM(CASE WHEN o.type='float_out' AND o.terminal_id=x.source_terminal_id AND o.note=CONCAT('Internal Transfer Out (Ref: ',x.reference,')') THEN l.amount END) source_out,SUM(CASE WHEN o.type='float_in' AND o.terminal_id=x.destination_terminal_id AND o.note=CONCAT('Internal Transfer In (Ref: ',x.reference,')') THEN l.amount END) destination_in FROM money_exchange_internal_transfers x JOIN money_exchange_till_operations o ON o.note IN (CONCAT('Internal Transfer Out (Ref: ',x.reference,')'),CONCAT('Internal Transfer In (Ref: ',x.reference,')')) JOIN money_exchange_till_operation_items l ON l.till_operation_id=o.id AND l.currency_code=x.currency_code WHERE x.reference='TRF-2026-1899' AND x.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status='completed' GROUP BY x.id) v ON v.id=x.id WHERE x.reference='TRF-2026-1899' AND x.deleted_at IS NULL
